subject: Architecture
title: Minoan Architecture: Europe's First Palaces
description: A quick win: understand Minoan Architecture: Europe's First Palaces.

hook.text: 3,500 years ago, Crete had palaces with plumbing, light wells, and multi-story buildings.

buildup.text: The Palace of Knossos had 1,300 rooms, frescoed walls, and an advanced drainage system.

discovery.text: Minoans used downward-tapering columns — wider at the top — unique in the ancient world.

twist.text: The complex layout of Knossos may have inspired the myth of the Minotaur's labyrinth.

climax.text: Minoan civilization collapsed suddenly around 1450 BC — possibly from a volcanic eruption on Thera.

punchline.text: Europe's first builders vanished. The maze they left spawned legends.

quiz.question: What myth may have been inspired by the Palace of Knossos?
